title: CLARA: coupled missing-status certificates and cost-optimal scientific clarification
status: New analysis specification recorded before completion-aware computations; not public preregistration
snapshot: Reuse the frozen 2026-10-06 public snapshot, preserving its pre-download protocol and raw hashes
scientific_model: Profiled specimens have their recorded consequence-class events; each unprofiled specimen has a latent state absent / broad-only / truncating, with truncating a subset of broad. This is an assay-record model, not pathogenicity or true per-base coverage.
patient_model: Cohort-mode positivity is an OR over all context-eligible specimens, including latent unprofiled specimens; profiled mode only includes mutation-profiled specimens. Partial patient observation is included in cohort bounds.
completion_constraint: Shared specimen statuses across alternatives; patient blocks independent, without population prevalence priors
inclusion: Every one of the existing 360 cohort-gene families and all 16 specifications. Do not select families on completion-aware results.
certificates: Sharp joint relative divergence, with exact rational threshold decisions
planning: All 24 fixed orders with identical stopping
Greedy expected violating-edge reduction per unit cost

prior_grid.interpretation: 81 product-Bernoulli scenario priors, not user population estimates

point_guard: A selected specification whose sharp completion interval exceeds 5 pp cannot support a point value within 2.5 pp under this model. Report an interval; clarification does not collect measurements.
threshold_grid: Existing 16 tolerance combinations, applied to sharp coupled certificates without outcome tuning
validation: Exhaustive global completion enumeration on small fixtures

Independent global linear-program support-function verification on all TCGA genomic family-pair primary labels; this snapshot has at most one unprofiled specimen per patient, making the patient OR affine
Planner policy paths agree with Bellman values

no_new_nlp_or_human_claim: No language parser, new user study, calibrated intent prior, clinical benefit, or acceptance guarantee
primary_claim: An executable application of separable robust fractional optimization and classical decision-tree planning; do not claim these general algorithms are new
